description: A working contract: how Claude works with the principal, in every project. One rules file, one hook file.

plugins.name: working-contract
plugins.description: Injects 29 working rules as SessionStart output, prints a three-row budget gauge each turn, and refuses a turn that ends without a card while a question is open. One rules file, one hook file, no dependencies and no network calls. macOS only for two of the gauge’s three rows; Node.js 20.11 or newer.
